title: Capital Gains Manual

HMRC is reviewing the CG Manual to ensure it provides
HMRC’s interpretation of relevant legislation where there is more than one
reasonable view of how rules work.Where material in the CG Manual isn’t
providing an interpretation, that material is being removed. Where appropriate,
material will be reproduced elsewhere and linked from the CG Manual.

title: Stamp Duty Land Tax Manual
summary:
Guidance on Stamp
Duty Land Tax (SDLT) which applies to land transactions in the UK from 1 December
2003. Since 1 April 2018 SDLT has applied to land transactions in England and
Northern Ireland only. 

Guidance for transactions in Scotland since 1 April 2015 can be found at theScottish
Government website. 

Guidance for transactions in Wales since 1April 2018 can be found at theWelsh
Revenue Authority.
